message:
fix(apk): an unanswered lease is not an older host; the cards follow the leases (keepalive-r2 2 e)

From the AVD (ke_r2, ke_r3):
- A lease whose StandbyHellos go unanswered may have met an older host OR a path that failed for now (ke_r2: the
  fixture's relay refused the host's answers). Codex: an unconfirmed / passing failure is never taken for an older
  version. So "PC 목록" tries again every time (only raw IP, a pre-login worker and a directory without standby end
  without trying), the unanswered mark only holds off the app's OWN preparation for 10 minutes, and the notice says
  "응답이 없습니다 (지원하지 않는 PC 이거나 연결 경로 문제)" instead of claiming an older version.
- The list is drawn again whenever a lease's status changes (and on a release): the card stayed at "대기 준비" while
  the lease was already parked (ke_r3 E2).

Unit tests 305/0.
